message.content:
A magazine cover titled "TEMPO" in large red letters features an illustration of a man with glasses and a mustache. On top of his head are numerous stacked brown boxes. At the very top of these boxes stands a bipedal figure with a bull's head, wearing a long brown robe and holding a thin staff. This figure is surrounded by several small white bags tied with red string.

The man’s head and shoulders fill much of the frame. He wears a grey jacket over a white collared shirt. To the left of his face, black text reads "BANCAKAN BANSOS BANTENG" in large bold letters. Above this, a paragraph of smaller text begins with "Jejak Ketua Komisi Hukum..." and ends with "...Perjuangan lain."

The upper portion of the cover contains the words "KISRUH KOMISI PEMILIHAN UMUM" and "MENYAMBUT ERA BANK DIGITAL," separated by a diagonal line. Below the main title is "50 Tahun!" in red script. A barcode and QR code are in the bottom right corner with the date "25-31 JANUARI 2021" and a price of "RP 45.000." A solid red border runs along the left and bottom edges.
